visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffused shadows shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] for floating bars
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for glass, border-white/5 for solid cards
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the dashboard background to remove digital flatness

components.floating_command_bar: Glassmorphism surface, rounded-full or rounded-xl, 1px inner border, highly responsive, placed at bottom center or attached to selection region.
components.selection_canvas: Semi-transparent dark overlay with a clear 'cutout' for the selected region. 1px solid accent color border with corner handles.
components.dashboard_cards: Flat background (surface), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift and border lightening.
components.action_buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded, high contrast (white bg, black text for primary).
components.toast: Use sonner for capture success/failure notifications, bottom-right placement.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Use for recent captures history.
grids_and_layouts.floating_overlay: Absolute positioned elements over a full-screen transparent canvas (pointer-events-none where not interactive).

motion.hover: Subtle border color transitions, slight scaling (scale-105) on interactive icons.
motion.entrance: Command bar slides up from bottom or expands from a point. Framer motion for layout animations.
motion.ai_processing: Shimmering gradient border (Tracing Beam) on the command bar or selection edge while AI is analyzing the capture.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against #05050A.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the tracing beam and slide animations.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., command-bar-input, capture-region-box).

dashboard_empty_state.description: Developer working in a dark room with multiple monitors, representing the target user.

ai_processing_bg.description: Abstract technology lines representing AI connections.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not recommended for the core extension overlay to maintain extreme performance and low latency. Might use light TSParticles for the dashboard hero if needed, but prioritize 2D DOM for speed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pure React/Tailwind frontend, no actual heavy OS native code needed, use a full-screen web overlay to mock the Windows desktop scaffold.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components for all forms.
Ensure 'Inter' is not used for headings.
Make the Command Bar highly interactive with hover states and a polished glassmorphic background.
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect on the boundary of the selected region when AI is 'processing' it.
Do not use generic gray text-on-gray backgrounds. Always ensure crisp contrast.
Create a clean separation between the 'Capture Overlay Mode' (transparent background with crosshairs/selection) and the 'Dashboard Mode' (dense bento grid).
Use the provided image URLs for avatars and placeholder backgrounds where appropriate.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
